newsitem.title: FRANCE: France extra 3.24 bln Ffr OATs after auction.
newsitem.headline: France extra 3.24 bln Ffr OATs after auction.

text.p: The Treasury said on Friday it sold 3.244 billion francs of OATs after Thursday's auction, raising the total value of bonds sold this week to 24.890 billion francs. Following are the final results:

NOTE - The Treasury originally announced it would sell 20 to 22 billion francs of OATs in total. The total bid cover ratio of the auction was 2.4.

Under the French system, primary dealers and central banks not only submit competitive bids at the auction, but also have the option, for a limited period after the sale, of buying extra bonds at the average auction price.
